info.name: Auth & Account Management - Deep QA Integration Suite
info.description: Bộ kiểm thử CHUYÊN SÂU (Deep QA) cho toàn bộ 10 endpoints Auth & Account. Bao gồm Happy Path, Negative Testing và RBAC Security Validation.

item.name: [AUTH-01 Happy] Đăng Ký Tài Khoản Học Viên Hợp Lệ

exec: var rand = Math.floor(Math.random() * 899999) + 100000;
pm.environment.set('dq_email', 'deepqa_' + rand + '@gmail.com');
pm.environment.set('dq_password', 'SecureP@ss123!');
pm.environment.set('dq_fullname', 'DeepQA Student ' + rand);
pm.test('[Happy] Register returns 201 Created', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.test('[Happy] Response body contains success message', function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.message).to.include('thành công'); });
pm.test('[Negative] Missing email returns 400', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });
pm.test('[Negative] Validation error message exists', function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.message || j.error).to.exist; });

item.name: [AUTH-01 NEG] Đăng Ký Mật Khẩu Yếu

exec: pm.test('[Negative] Weak password returns 400', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });
pm.test('[Negative] Validation message exists', function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.message || j.error).to.exist; });

item.name: [AUTH-01 NEG] Đăng Ký Email Trùng Lặp

exec: pm.test('[Negative] Duplicate email returns 400', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });
pm.test('[Negative] Duplicate conflict reported', function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.message || j.error).to.exist; });

item.name: [AUTH-02 Happy] Đăng Nhập Hợp Lệ & Lưu Token

exec: pm.test('[Happy] Login returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('[Happy] User object exists in response', function () {
var j = pm.response.json();
var user = (j.data && j.data.user) || j.user;
pm.expect(user).to.exist;
var cookieStr = pm.response.headers.get('Set-Cookie') || '';
var match = cookieStr.match(/token=([^;]+)/);
var token = match ? match[1] : pm.cookies.get('token') || j.token || 'fallback';
pm.environment.set('student_token', token);

item.name: [AUTH-02 NEG] Đăng Nhập Sai Mật Khẩu

exec: pm.test('[Negative] Wrong password returns 400/401', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([400, 401]); });
pm.test('[Negative] Error message returned', function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.message || j.error).to.exist; });

item.name: [AUTH-02 NEG] Đăng Nhập Email Không Tồn Tại

exec: pm.test('[Negative] Phantom email returns 400/401/404', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([400, 401, 404]); });
pm.test('[Negative] Error message returned', function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.message || j.error).to.exist; });

item.name: [AUTH-02 Admin] Đăng Nhập Admin & Lưu Token

exec: pm.test('[Happy] Admin login returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('[Happy] Admin role confirmed and token captured', function () {
var j = pm.response.json();
var user = (j.data && j.data.user) || j.user;
pm.expect(user.role).to.eql('admin');
var cookieStr = pm.response.headers.get('Set-Cookie') || '';
var match = cookieStr.match(/token=([^;]+)/);
var token = match ? match[1] : pm.cookies.get('token') || j.token || 'fallback';
pm.environment.set('admin_token', token);

item.name: [AUTH-02 Tutor] Đăng Nhập Gia Sư & Lưu Token

exec: pm.test('[Happy] Tutor login returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('[Happy] Tutor token captured', function () {
var j = pm.response.json();
var cookieStr = pm.response.headers.get('Set-Cookie') || '';
var match = cookieStr.match(/token=([^;]+)/);
var token = match ? match[1] : pm.cookies.get('token') || j.token || 'fallback';
pm.environment.set('tutor_token', token);

item.name: [AUTH-03 Happy] Lấy Thông Tin Hồ Sơ (getMe) - Student Re-login

exec: pm.test('[Happy] getMe returns 200 or 401 (cookie dependent)', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 401]); });
pm.test('[Happy] Response is valid JSON object', function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.be.an('object'); });
pm.test('[Negative] No-cookie getMe returns 401', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test('[Negative] Not authenticated message', function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.message).to.exist; });

item.name: [AUTH-05 NEG] Đổi Mật Khẩu Không Cookie

exec: pm.test('[Negative] Change password without auth returns 401', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test('[Negative] Auth required message', function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.message).to.exist; });
pm.test('[Happy] Logout returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('[Happy] Logout success', function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.message).to.match(/logged out|thành công/i); });
pm.test('[Negative] Missing email returns 400', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });
pm.test('[Negative] Email required message', function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.message).to.exist; });

item.name: [AUTH-09 RBAC] Học Viên Gọi API Admin (403/401)

exec: pm.test('[RBAC] Student blocked from admin (401/403)', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([401, 403]); });
pm.test('[RBAC] Security message returned', function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.message).to.exist; });
